stem: One of these angles is a right angle. Which one?
figure_description:
Four angles labeled A, B, C, and D:
- Option A shows two connected line segments meeting at an apex pointing upward, one segment sloping down to the left at roughly 45° and the other sloping down to the right at roughly 45°.
- Option B shows two connected line segments meeting at a bottom vertex, one extending nearly vertically upward and the other slanting upward and to the right, forming an angle of approximately 25°.
- Option C shows two connected line segments meeting at a top vertex, one extending vertically downward and the other slanting downward and to the left, forming an angle of approximately 20°.
- Option D shows two connected line segments meeting at a bottom vertex, one slanting downward to the right and the other extending horizontally to the right, forming an angle of approximately 120°.
